culprit_citations.quoted_text: GB Eagle Buyer, Inc. ... Cost (4) $ 10,179 ... Fair Value $ 10,179 ...
Targeted roam query for CAD and EUR returned n_hits=0 across the filing source.

findings.detail: Four fair_value_currency rows were stored as U_CAD or U_EUR even though the source fair value schedule presents cost and fair value in USD and contains no CAD/EUR source terms.

rationale: FX02 is a Class 1 currency-cell validation. The flagged artifact reports four fair_value_currency values as U_CAD/U_EUR, but the raw SOI source presents the Cost and Fair Value columns with dollar signs, including individual investment rows and the total debt investment line. A targeted roam query for CAD/EUR found no source presentation supporting foreign-currency fair value units. The non-USD fair_value_currency values are therefore a real extraction/tag carry-through defect rather than a false alarm.
